description:
Turn a time from find_appointment_times into a link the guest taps to finish booking. This does NOT book anything: it returns a short-lived URL on the venue's own booking page, already opened at that service, that staff member and that exact time, where the guest enters their own name, email and phone and confirms.

Give the guest the `url` and say plainly that the booking is not made until they open it. Never ask the guest for their contact details to pass here; this tool does not take them, and the page collects them directly. Nothing is reserved in the meantime, so a popular time can still go before they tap.

serviceId.description: The same service id passed to find_appointment_times, from get_venue. The link opens on this service.

slotToken.description: A `slotToken` from find_appointment_times or find_table_times, copied exactly. It is signed and carries the venue and the time inside the signature, so it cannot be edited, built by hand, or used at a different venue. It expires about 30 minutes after the search.

venue.description: The venue's booking slug, exactly as get_venue returned it or as it appears in the venue's own booking link: the last path segment of gaplessly.com/book/<slug>, or the first label of <slug>.gaplessly.com. Not the business name.

name: start_appointment_booking
title: Start an appointment booking
